notes: Hand written and synthetic, never captured. Room looks as the Aabahran server prints them, built from its own format strings and area files, with a Room.Chars packet before the text where the server sends one. Each line says where it comes from, room says whether it lists a thing or a person, the lines a Room trigger matches, and preset names any other color the Room and time colors preset gives it. Tolliver and Maren are invented names. README.md has the details. Read by src-tauri/src/session_room_tests.rs and crates/trigger/src/engine.rs.
